name: cavemio-area-chart
title: Area chart
description: Several series stacked, overlapping or as shares: every band morphs between layouts, and the tiles are the legend, the switches and the readout.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The layout switch is a radio group; the tiles are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) and the last visible series can’t be hidden.
- The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between points and every visible series is announced.
- Identity never rests on colour alone: each tile pairs its swatch with the series name, and every value is in a visually hidden table.
- Colours come from the theme’s --chart-1 to --chart-5 and follow the series, not its rank, so hiding one never repaints the others.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion every change happens in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: series
props.description: – · Up to five, each { id, label, values }, coloured --chart-1 to --chart-5 in this order.

props.name: labels
props.description: – · Along the bottom, one per point; they thin out on narrow screens.

props.name: titles
props.description: – · Longer names for the readout, e.g. "Week of 28 September".

props.name: caption
props.description: – · Under the total, e.g. "in the last 12 weeks".

features.title: Three layouts, one chart
features.description: Stacked, Overlap or 100%: the bands morph to their new places and the scale rolls between counts and percentages.

features.title: A legend you can press
features.description: Each tile hides or shows its series while the others settle into the room. The last one showing can’t be hidden.

features.title: A readout on hover
features.description: A thin line follows the pointer and the tiles turn into that point’s figures and shares.

features.title: It draws itself in
features.description: The first time the card is in view the bands are revealed from left to right.

features.title: Keyboard and table
features.description: The plot is one tab stop with arrow keys, and every value is also in a visually hidden table.

features.title: Colours from your theme
features.description: Up to five series take --chart-1 to --chart-5 in order and keep them when another is hidden.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, the bands are revealed from left to right (1200ms) and every figure rolls up from zero.

states.title: layout
states.description: The pill is thrown to Stacked, Overlap or 100% (460ms); every band’s top and bottom tween to the new layout (620ms) and the scale rolls to counts or percentages.

states.title: toggle
states.description: A tile is a toggle button: its band fades and collapses to nothing while the others restack, its swatch empties and its figures roll to zero; pressing again reverses it. The last series showing can’t be hidden.

states.title: hover
states.description: A thin line glides to the nearest point (260ms, slight overshoot) with a dot on each band; the caption morphs to that point’s name and the total, the tiles’ figures and shares roll to it.
